shared_contract.authentication: DRF IsAuthenticated and BaseSessionAuthentication; inactive/missing sessions are anonymous; CSRF disabled. TimezoneMixin activates authenticated user_timezone after DRF initial authentication/permission/content negotiation.
shared_contract.workspace_authorization: Decorated handlers require an undeleted active WorkspaceMember for receiver and slug with role exactly 5,15,20. No joined Workspace.deleted_at or Project.deleted_at/archived_at test is present. Missing, inactive, soft-deleted or other-role membership gives 403 {error: You don't have the required permissions.}. Duplicate memberships use exists, not single-row get.
shared_contract.receiver_scope: Every notification lookup restricts notification.deleted_at IS NULL, receiver_id=current user and workspace.slug=path slug. Related workspace/project/triggered_by deletion or inactivity does not independently hide a notification.
shared_contract.query_parsing: Django QueryDict get takes last scalar value. Blank values remain blank. Reuse original-query field-count limit and shared percent-decoding behavior. Search, fields, expand, group_by, sub_group_by and unrelated filters have no notification-domain effect. format remains a shared negotiation input.
shared_contract.serializer: NotificationSerializer fields=__all__; exact common response fields defined by notification_schema. List adds 3 annotated booleans; detail and mutations omit these absent annotations. triggered_by_details is null when triggered_by is null; otherwise full UserLiteSerializer even for inactive related user (User has no deleted_at column). No fields/expand projection.
shared_contract.transport: UUID pk Django converter requires canonical lowercase hyphenated UUID shape; malformed paths never reach view. HEAD exists for collection/detail/unread and executes GET without body. OPTIONS and unsupported methods follow shared DRF protocol; action methods do not acquire GET/HEAD. Slashless redirects, session cookies, CORS, content negotiation, request size and compression must use shared compatibility stack.
shared_contract.ownership: Go owns list, detail and unread-count GET plus routable read protocol companions. Django retains all seven writes. Detail OPTIONS, writes and slashless detail stay on Django through production Caddy; direct Go mirrors source metadata without exposing write handlers.

notification_schema.avatar_url: User.avatar_url uses related asset.asset_url when asset exists, else nonempty avatar, else null. FileAsset.entity_type selects static, issue-attachment, description URL or null; do not assume every asset is a static avatar. Source: db/models/user.py::avatar_url and db/models/asset.py::asset_url.
notification_schema.dates: DRF DateTimeField representation uses active requester timezone and ISO8601; null remains null.
